4823-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4210-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

719-2034-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-2034-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5686-6854--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 5.

225-3129-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Spark Double and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

129-1409-1753-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4091-4137-7791.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Repeat.

413-3276-5038-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
When the Zombie(s) enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat as needed.

5078-5741-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3259-4053-4359-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-4359-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-4359-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

1558-2638-3478-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3478-4231-4365.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

222-527-2921-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-5921-5970-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

955-1563-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-5295-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

876-4924-7070.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
876-4924-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

3259-5484-7060.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5484-7060.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5231-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5231-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3188-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2103-4423-4935-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-4935-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

2014-3055-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

632-969-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-969-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-4063.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1580-2921-4871-5542.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

765-1479-5361.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2584-3967-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Yahenni is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1354-1835-4094-4275.notablePrerequisites:
Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1354-1835-4094-4275.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat from step 2.

232-618-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
232-618-3263-4222.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {3}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

63-933-1558-4231.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

618-3043-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least four creatures with defender.
618-3043-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Axebane Guardian with haste.
Activate the Axebane Guardian token by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color(s).
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1171-2034-4068-5003.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding three mana of any one color.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garth One-Eye, adding {C}{C}.
Garth One-Eye dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Garth One-Eye from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

156-4475.description:
Cast Scourge of the Skyclaves kicked for {5}{B}{B}.
When it enters the battlefield, each player loses half of their life, rounded up.
At the beginning of the end step Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose the other half of their life.

2034-2730-3524-5131.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gleaming Barrier, adding {C}{C}.
Gleaming Barrier triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Muldrotha, adding {C}{C}.
Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, targeting Muldrotha.
Cast Gleaming Barrier from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may cast Gleaming Barrier twice each loop instead of only once, choosing "artifact" for Muldrotha purposes one time and "creature" the other time, resulting in infinite Treasure tokens.

2744-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2744-4050-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
